# ImageRefold

> ImageRefold is a free, open-source Figma plugin, in development, that exports layers as compressed WebP, AVIF, JPG and PNG images and brings images into Figma already compressed. Every image is encoded on the user's computer: no account, no server, no analytics and no limits. Made by Shades Media Group.

## Facts

- Status: in development. The first release will be published in the Figma Community.
- Price: free forever. No plans, limits, trials, accounts, upgrade prompts or watermarks. MIT licence.
- Formats: WebP, AVIF, JPG and PNG, lossy or lossless, with one quality control.
- Sizes: 0.5×, 0.75×, 1×, 1.5×, 2×, 3×, 4× or an exact width, several in one export.
- Preview: each file's size and saving before it is saved, with the original beside the result.
- Batches: every selected layer at once, as separate files or one ZIP, named by a pattern.
- Import: images dropped into the plugin are compressed before they are placed; heavy image fills can be replaced in place to make a Figma file smaller.
- Privacy: images are encoded inside the plugin. Its manifest allows no network access, so Figma blocks any request.
- Languages: this site is in English, French, Romanian, Russian, Spanish, Italian, Turkish, Hindi, Japanese, Simplified and Traditional Chinese. The plugin is in English.
- Current version: {{@version}}.
